name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: The 3D cover-flow carousel and a full-width slider, with drag, swipe, keyboard, indicators and accessible autoplay.
improvements: Dragging uses Pointer Events with touch-action: pan-y, so vertical swipes still scroll the page (Materialize blocked it with non-passive touch listeners).
Only horizontal drags are captured, and taps are told apart from drags, so links and buttons inside slides work on touch screens.
Carousel and slide roles with "n of N" labels, previous/next buttons, arrow keys and polite announcements.
Optional autoplay pauses on hover and focus, starts paused under reduced motion and has a visible pause button (WCAG 2.2.2).
Controlled activeIndex plus an imperative ref with next, prev and set; re-measures on resize with a ResizeObserver.
